title: Choose a complete conversion or an explicit partial APEX draft
changes: Preview supported forms and omissions before creating a separate demo source version.
Original sources stay saved; draft scope is visible in projects, runs and downloadable evidence.
Technically verified native output can be downloaded for development without claiming business acceptance.
Next-action guidance, setup status and recorded target versions make the APEX handoff clearer.
Lost draft-creation responses are checked against saved scope rather than automatically replayed.
limitations: Experimental preview: partial drafts omit behavior; they do not translate arbitrary triggers, libraries or reports.
Raw Forms binaries still require supported Oracle tooling; unsupported schema or field mapping is not guessed.
APEX generated, technical checks passed and business acceptance remain separate.
Release notes describe software changes, not proof of a successful conversion.
